reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Alabama
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Is there a state/territory law regulating residential evictions?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario facts (question)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(alabama).
scenario_year(2021).
scenario_topic(residential_evictions).

% Helper predicate summarizing the scenario in logic form.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(alabama),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_topic(residential_evictions),
    !.

/* ==========================================
   Statute translations: AL Code  35-9A-141
   (2021) - Definitions in Alabama URLTA
   ========================================== */

% We model that  35-9A-141 is part of Alabama's residential landlord-tenant chapter.
% This is important because the question asks about "residential evictions".
statute_part_of_residential_landlord_tenant_chapter(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141) :- !.

% Deterministic predicate capturing key statutory definitions.
% Citation: AL Code  35-9A-141 (2021)

statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, action,
    'Includes recoupment, counterclaim, set-off, suit in equity, and any other proceeding in which rights are determined, including an action for possession.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, building_and_housing_codes,
    'Includes any law, ordinance, or governmental regulation concerning fitness for habitation or construction, maintenance, operation, occupancy, use, or appearance of any premises or dwelling unit.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, day,
    'Means calendar day; if the last day falls on a weekend or official holiday, the last day is the next official business day when the court is open.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, dwelling_unit,
    'A structure or part of a structure (including a manufactured home) rented as a home, residence, or sleeping place by one or more persons.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, eviction,
    'A civil action filed as a remedy where a tenant lawfully took possession and fails or refuses, after termination of the tenant possessory interest, to deliver possession to one lawfully entitled (or agent/attorney).') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, good_faith,
    'Honesty in fact in the conduct of the transaction concerned.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, landlord,
    'Owner, lessor, or sublessor of the dwelling unit or building, and also a manager of the premises.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, organization,
    'Includes corporation, government, subdivision/agency, business trust, estate, trust, partnership/association, two or more persons with a joint/common interest, and any business entity.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, owner,
    'Person(s) with legal title or beneficial ownership and right to present use/enjoyment; includes mortgagee only when in possession.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, person,
    'Includes an individual, individuals, or organization.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, premises,
    'A dwelling unit and structure, facilities/appurtenances, and grounds/areas/facilities for tenant use generally or promised by rental agreement.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, rent,
    'All payments to be made to or for the benefit of the landlord under the rental agreement.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, rental_agreement,
    'All agreements (written or oral) and valid rules/regulations adopted under Section 35-9A-302 embodying terms/conditions of use and occupancy.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, roomer,
    'Person occupying a dwelling unit lacking certain facilities (toilet, refrigerator, stove, kitchen sink, and bath/shower) provided by landlord, with one or more used in common.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, single_family_residence,
    'Structure maintained and used as a single dwelling unit; may share walls but must have direct street access and share no heating/hot water/essential service with other units.') :- !.
statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, tenant,
    'A person entitled under a rental agreement to occupy a dwelling unit to the exclusion of others.') :- !.

% Helper: the statute defines "eviction" in 2021 Alabama law.
statute_defines_eviction_term(alabama, 2021) :-
    statute_definition(alabama, 2021, al_code_35_9a_141, eviction, _),
    !.

/* =====================================================
   Legal reasoning: does Alabama have a law regulating
   residential evictions (as of focus_year)?
   ===================================================== */

% We treat "regulating residential evictions" as satisfied if the state has a
% residential landlord-tenant statute that defines "eviction" as a civil action remedy.
% (This is sufficient for existence of a state law addressing/regulating evictions.)
state_law_regulating_residential_evictions(State, Year) :-
    statute_part_of_residential_landlord_tenant_chapter(State, Year, al_code_35_9a_141),
    statute_defines_eviction_term(State, Year),
    !.

/* ======================
   Final answer predicate
   ====================== */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_topic(residential_evictions),
    state_law_regulating_residential_evictions(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =================
   Main entrypoint
   ================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is there a state/territory law regulating residential evictions?
